body:
Thank you for this report and for the test file.

This looks like the same defect as #2004 ("Depth-stepping operations cut a first level at Top Z that removes no material", P2). The shared depth-level rule starts its first level at Top Z, so the first pass of a 2D Contour (and of other depth-stepping operations) cuts air. That is why changing the top and clearance heights does not help.

The fix is PR #2013: the depth ladder starts one stepdown under Top Z. It is in review now. Your `2d_contour_test_v2.zip` is a good check for it. When #2013 merges, please try your file again on a build from `main`.

Analysis by issue-worker-high (no claim, no branch, no code).

I read the attached `2d_contour_test_v2.camproj`:
- The stock box is 5 mm high. The stock top is Z 5. The model top is also Z 5.
- The 2D Contour has Top Z = top of model (Z 5), Bottom Z = bottom of model - 1 (Z -1), and stepdown 10.
- The saved toolpath cuts two levels: Z 5 (17 feed moves) and Z -1 (17 feed moves). The level at Z 5 is in air, because no stock is above Top Z.

Cause: the shared level ladder `cut_levels` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/levels.rs` starts its first level at Top Z. This is the defect of #2004. It is not a separate defect of the 2D Contour.

The fix is in PR #2013 (branch `issue/2004-top-z-level`, head `7cb6472cb`). On that branch, `cut_levels_under(5, None, -1, 10)` gives the one level `[-1]`. The contour of the reporter then cuts one pass at Z -1 and no pass at Z 5. When stock stands over Top Z, the level at Top Z stays, so that case does not change.

The case is already pinned on that branch: `top_z_level::a_contour_whose_stepdown_spans_the_depth_cuts_one_level` (motion) asserts one level at Bottom Z and none at Top Z. A second pin for this file adds no new coverage, so I did not open a stacked PR.

Recommendation: keep this issue open until #2013 merges. The body of #2013 refers only to #2004, so this issue does not close automatically. After the merge, close this issue as fixed by the merge commit of #2013, and ask the reporter to check the file on a build from `main`.
